_meta.districts_note: 33 districts, unchanged since Mulugu and Narayanpet were created on 17 Feb 2019. Hanumakonda (formerly Warangal Urban) and Warangal (formerly Warangal Rural) were renamed AND had a boundary change on 12 Aug 2021, so third-party area and population figures for those two are commonly stale; the figures here are the post-2021 official ones.
_meta.telugu_note: Every district carries its Telugu spelling. Stage 2 reads raw post text, so a district without a Telugu name is invisible in Telugu-language posts.
_meta.subdivisions_note: Telangana has 76 revenue divisions and 621 mandals (Revenue Minister, Assembly, 17 Dec 2024) — NOT the 74/594 that older sources still repeat. Per-district mandal counts here are LOW CONFIDENCE: they sum to less than the official total and official pages contradict each other. Do not use them for arithmetic.
_meta.talukas_note: Deliberately EMPTY. No authoritative machine-readable list of the 621 mandals was obtained, and inventing names would turn every one into a false geo-match.

centroid.source: True area-weighted polygon centroid computed from the OpenStreetMap administrative boundary relation for Telangana (OSM relation 3250963, 8058 boundary vertices, fetched via Nominatim details with polygon_geojson=1). Alternatives: bounding-box midpoint 17.876860/79.279605; en.wikipedia Geography of Telangana representative point 17.9/79.3; Nominatim label point 17.8495919/79.1151663.

bbox.source: Computed from the OpenStreetMap administrative boundary relation for Telangana (OSM relation 3250963); identical to 7 dp with Nominatim's own reported bbox for the same relation. NOT the textbook '15°46'-19°47'N / 77°16'-81°43'E' extent, whose eastern limit of 81.717 reflects the pre-2014 boundary before the Bhadrachalam-division mandals east of the Godavari were transferred to Andhra Pradesh.
